record.title: Execute authorized single SCPI identity checkpoint
record.intent: Capture one bounded identity exchange under isolated host networking, then restore temporary host state.
requirements: Admit and commit tasking before execution. Preserve a new private run and baseline; verify interface identity, lease lifetime, normal default route and no forwarding, sharing, NAT, bridging or DHCP service.
Start and verify a fresh full Ethernet capture through the corrected recorder before assigning the temporary host address. Stop on recorder failure, unexpected traffic, UI prompt or isolation change.

Under healthy capture assign only the isolated temporary host address. Make at most one interface-bound TCP connection to the leased specimen on port 5555 and send exactly one LF-terminated *IDN? query, with bounded deadlines and no retry.
Preserve raw request and response and exact identity fields privately. No option query, Web Control, ADB, USB, discovery, scans, lease renewal or device configuration.

Remove only the temporary host address under capture, stop gracefully with drop statistics, verify restoration and seal artifacts and hashes. A failed prerequisite or negative attempt is valid evidence; do not broaden the run.
acceptance: One bounded result or preflight stop is preserved with explicit limits and restoration evidence.
